stories.story_fr: L'international tire toute la croissance pendant que l'Amerique du Nord cale : au Q3 FY2025 le revenu International a bondi de 33% et les ventes comparables de 18%, alors que les comparables Americas reculaient de 5%. Le moteur de croissance s'est deplace hors des Etats-Unis.
stories.story_en: International is carrying all the growth while North America stalls: in Q3 FY2025 International net revenue jumped 33% and comparable sales rose 18%, while Americas comparable sales fell 5%. The growth engine has shifted outside the US.
stories.signal: International net revenue increased 33%. Americas comparable sales decreased 5%.

stories.story_fr: Sous Calvin McDonald, lululemon a plus que triple ses revenus annuels, etendu sa presence a plus de 30 geographies et fait de la Chine continentale son deuxieme marche mondial. La societe vise environ 11 milliards de dollars de revenu annuel pour l'exercice en cours.
stories.story_en: Under Calvin McDonald, lululemon more than tripled annual revenues, broadened reach to over 30 geographies and grew China Mainland into its second largest market. The company expects to generate around $11 billion in annual revenue this fiscal year.
stories.signal: grew the company's China Mainland business into its second largest market

stories.story_fr: Changement de direction au sommet : Calvin McDonald quitte son poste de CEO effectif au 31 janvier 2026. La DAF Meghan Frank et le directeur commercial Andre Maestrini assurent l'interim en co-CEO pendant que le conseil mene une recherche de successeur, signe d'une periode de transition strategique.
stories.story_en: Leadership shake-up at the top: Calvin McDonald steps down as CEO effective January 31, 2026. CFO Meghan Frank and Chief Commercial Officer Andre Maestrini serve as interim co-CEOs while the board runs a search, signaling a period of strategic transition.
stories.signal: Meghan Frank, Chief Financial Officer, and Andre Maestrini, Chief Commercial Officer, will serve as interim co-CEOs
